purpose: Fresh Gate 3 tranche C ambiguous-follow-up cases that must request clarification instead of guessing.

cases.question: Can I use that card as a Tactic?

history.content: Compare Advance Guard and Compound Interest for me.
Advance Guard changes movement and has a battle effect; Compound Interest is an Asset that works with Treasury.

cases.question: Can I use that ability before dice?

history.content: Onward gives the General extra movement; Repel makes an opponent retreat farther after the Commandant wins as defender.

cases.question: Can I swap that card back into Reserve after it reveals?

history.content: How are Confession and Black Covenant different as Tactics?
Confession interacts with an opposing face-down Tactic; Black Covenant gives Advantage and an extra Tactic from Hand.
